articles.summary: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, today reported financial results for the third quarter of 2026 and recent business highlights. "Our third quarter reflects continued execution across both cardiovascular programs," said Kevin Koch, Ph.D., President and Chief Executive Officer of Edgewise. "In HCM, positive CIRRUS-HCM Part D results and our JCI Insight publication reinforce the differentiated profile of EDG-7500, and we expect to initiate our Phase 3 trial by year-end 2026. In parallel, we dosed our first patient in the Phase 2 EQUINOX-HFpEF trial of EDG-15400, our selective cardiac sarcomere modulator designed to address impaired cardiac relaxation in HFpEF." articles.summary: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, today announced favorable feedback from its End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for EDG-7500 in symptomatic obstructive and nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). As part of the End-of-Phase 2 meeting, Edgewise presented data from the ongoing CIRRUS-HCM Phase 2 study and Edgewise's proposed STRATUS-HCM Phase 3 design. Following the meeting and subsequent receipt of the minutes, Edgewise has submitted the STRATUS-HCM protocol incorporating the overall study design and assessments, including its proposed dose escalation plan. Under this protocol, the investigator will escalate the dose based on their assessment of tolerability, and no echocardiograms will be required to guide dosing decisions.
